example.title: United States Post Office (Shawano, Wisconsin)
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (NRHP-listed New Deal post office)

brief: One-storey New Deal-era federal post office in red brick with limestone trim, set up on a raised base: a symmetrical front of tall multi-pane windows in stone surrounds around a central entrance reached by steps with iron railings, a stone frieze with 'UNITED STATES POST OFFICE' lettering and a flat roof behind a stone-coped parapet. A tall flagpole, a lawn strip, shrubs and a blue collection box sit along the street.
